sources.summary: Dezeen School Shows: a gravity-powered mountain trike designed to extend mountain tourism beyond the ski season is among the projects from the University of Ljubljana. Also featured is biodegradable play equipment made from urban leaf waste and a multisensory exhibition system designed to make artworks more accessible to blind and partially sighted visitors.
